page.notes: The left edge of the scan is cropped, so the first letter or two of many lines are cut off; those lines are given as far as they are visible (e.g. "leo", "homam", "editatur", "norbo"). A small stray mark (a dot) stands in the right margin beside "non" on the line "At nobis non libet"; it is not a note. Long s is written as s throughout. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept.
